tool: Built-in image_gen color-look edit plus native Unity color transfer
prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather (COLOR GRADING ONLY).
Input image 1 is the edit target: a detailed warm-orange beach sand closeup.
Input image 2 is ONLY the color reference: the existing room's pale golden cream sand in its lower half, between and underneath where the game props sit.
Change ONLY the color grade of image 1 to match the lighter, less saturated pale-golden cream sand of reference image 2. Reduce the excessive orange saturation by approximately 23 percent and slightly raise brightness, while keeping a natural warm sandy hue, not gray or white. Match the reference sand's cream highlights and gentle peach midtones.
Preserve the exact full image 1 canvas, all grain texture, ripple positions, fine flecks, fine-detail contrast, sharpness and surface topology. No blur, no smoothing, no painted-over texture, no new objects, no new rocks, no footprints, no borders or text. This is a subtle production color-match pass, not a redesign or new texture. Keep an opaque background.
method: Matched mean RGB of extended sand to reference core sand using constant RGB offsets with the existing feather mask. Grain topology and high-frequency detail retained; no resampling, blur or sharpening. Sky, sea, core sand and four props are unchanged.
